name: scanflick-tauri
author: Niclas Lindstedt <niclas@agilator.se>
description: Desktop wrapper around the Scandinavian Flick PWA — bundles the game on-device and serves it from a private scheme, in the platform's own webview. See README.md.

scripts.start: npm run bundle && npm run build && cargo run --bin scanflick --
scripts.lint: npm run icons && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
